headline: Gold prices drop significantly in Bangladesh, impacting market
summary: The price of gold has seen a substantial decrease in Bangladesh, affecting consumers and the broader market. This marks a significant shift after recent price hikes.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have experienced a notable decline, with significant reductions reported per bhori (a unit of weight). This drop comes after a period of rising prices, offering some relief to consumers.

The Bangladesh Jewellers' Association (BAJUS) announced the new rates on July 6, 2026. The price of 22-carat gold per bhori has fallen by BDT 1,166, settling at BDT 117,528. Similarly, 21-carat gold is now priced at BDT 112,200 per bhori, down by BDT 1,091.

Further adjustments were made to other gold and silver categories. 18-carat gold is now BDT 96,168 per bhori, a decrease of BDT 933. The price of silver also saw a reduction, with standard silver priced at BDT 1,600 per bhori, down by BDT 41.

This price adjustment is expected to influence consumer purchasing behavior and the overall gold market dynamics in the country. Market analysts are observing the situation closely to gauge the long-term impact of this price fall.

headline: Saudi Crown Prince invites PM Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia
summary: The invitation was conveyed through the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Dr. Abdullah Zafar H. bin Abiya, during a courtesy meeting in Dhaka.
details: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has invited Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia. The information was shared by the Prime Minister's Foreign Affairs Advisor, Humayun Kabir, on Monday.
The invitation was formally extended during a courtesy meeting between the Prime Minister and the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Dr. Abdullah Zafar H. bin Abiya, in Dhaka.
During the meeting, the Saudi Ambassador handed over a formal letter from Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the Prime Minister.
Advisor Humayun Kabir stated that the visit and the meeting are expected to further strengthen the mutual and economic relations between Bangladesh and Saudi Arabia.
caption:
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has officially invited Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia.

Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has invited Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to visit Saudi Arabia. The information was shared by the Prime Minister's Foreign Affairs Advisor, Humayun Kabir, on Monday.

The invitation was formally extended during a courtesy meeting between the Prime Minister and the Saudi Ambassador to Bangladesh, Dr. Abdullah Zafar H. bin Abiya, in Dhaka.

During the meeting, the Saudi Ambassador handed over a formal letter from Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the Prime Minister.

Advisor Humayun Kabir stated that the visit and the meeting are expected to further strengthen the mutual and economic relations between Bangladesh and Saudi Arabia.

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star, Somoy News
